records.name: Cluinn
records.tagline: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.

records.name: ilse
records.tagline: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code

The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

records.name: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)

records.name: Nocto

Using Web Workers, HTML5 Canvas, and Web Crypto, it converts PDFs to Word/Excel/PPT/JPG, merges 750MB PDFs, repairs 25MB JSON payloads, formats 19 SQL dialects, compresses HEIC/WebP/JPG images to exact KB targets with SSIM scoring, and models 2026–27 payroll taxes locally in your browser RAM with zero server uploads.

records.name: BriefCheck
records.tagline: A cosmetic compliance analysis tool
records.description: BriefCheck is an AI-powered cosmetic compliance analysis tool that helps beauty brands verify their formulations against FDA, EU, Japan, and China regulations before manufacturing. Submit your ingredients, product type, claims, and target markets → get a compliance score and detailed risk report in under a minute. Perfect for: - Indie beauty founders shipping to multiple markets - Formulators testing formulations across regions - Small brands that can't afford $500/hr compliance consultants

records.name: Refract
records.tagline: Turns one note into a native post for every network
records.description: Refract is a social media scheduler for creators, small teams and agencies. You write one short note, and an AI agent for each network turns it into a post that fits there: the right length, tone, format and hashtags. You review and approve every version, then Refract schedules it. Works with Bluesky, Mastodon, Pixelfed, Pinterest, Tumblr, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WordPress, DEV and YouTube, plus an API and MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT.

records.name: OcheSlate
records.tagline: Private offline X01 scoring and practice log
records.description: Score 301, 501, or 701 for up to four players, handle straight- or double-out busts, review match facts, and practice Around the Clock or Doubles Ladder. OcheSlate works fully offline with auditable corrections and verified backups.

records.name: Story Checkers
records.tagline: AI checks if the story in a video holds up
records.description: Story Checkers lets anyone upload a video and get an honest check of whether the story holds up. Verbal and non-verbal signals are analysed separately, with a percentage. Not a lie detector. Built by a solo founder in Ghent, Belgium.

records.name: Buy Bhang Goli Online (Pack of 60)
records.tagline: Pure Bhang Goli Pack of 60 – Premium Quality Online
records.description: Experience premium quality when you order Bhang Goli (Pack of 60) online in India at OnePlant. We take pride in delivering uncompromised purity by sourcing 100% genuine botanical ingredients carefully crafted under strict quality standards. Each goli offers precise consistency and traditional herbal efficacy, making it ideal for regular users who appreciate authentic formulation. With OnePlant, shopping online is seamless, secure, and stress-free.

records.name: AkordoBot
records.tagline: Sell time slots & digital goods in Telegram with 0% fees
records.description: Selling expert services and digital goods in Telegram. Not a marketplace – your clients stay yours. Sell bookings for consultations and meetings as slots. Sell digital goods delivered right after payment. Gram, ETH, USDT(TON/TRON/ETH), USDC(ETH). Payments go directly to the expert/seller – no access to your funds. iCal calendar sync – busy overlay (up to 10 calendars). Type @AkordoBot in any chat to manage availability, add meetings, or view bookings.

records.name: Veilkin, company while you game
records.tagline: An AI companion who sees your game and chats while you play
records.description: Some of my best gaming memories are of someone sat beside me, watching me play. Veilkin brings that feeling to your solo sessions. It’s an AI companion that sees your screen, so you can chat about the game like you would with a mate on the sofa. Laugh at a daft death, ask where to go next, or just chat. It remembers your games, too. Hold a key to talk or tap a key to type, and it replies in text. You choose how chatty it is, and it fades back over your game when you want quiet.

records.name: DidWeFeed
records.tagline: Shared pet care: feeding, walks and meds, all in sync
records.description: “Did we feed the dog?” Now everyone knows. Most pet apps are a diary for one person. DidWeFeed is a live checklist for the whole household: one tap logs a meal, a walk or a dose, and everyone sees it, helping avoid duplicate care. Reminders only come for what’s still open. Walks are tracked with GPS, and the pet file keeps vaccinations, vet visits and a vet-ready report in one place. Medication tracking is free. Built for my dog Choci in Graz. Free beta on iOS and Android → didwefeed.app/beta

records.name: Anas kesav
records.tagline: Digital Marketing Specialist in Kerala | Anas Kesav
records.description: Anas Kesav is a Digital Marketing Specialist in Kerala, specializing in SEO, social media marketing, content marketing and digital advertising to grow brands online.

records.name: Lights Down
records.tagline: Pick tonight's movie, solo or with someone
records.description: Most movie pickers make you both swipe the same deck. Lights Down blends your taste and theirs into one list for tonight, from the services you already pay for. About a minute of swiping learns your taste and ends with which of twelve Cinematic Archetypes™ you are. Then pick a mood and get a short list of movies and series, with where each one is streaming. Solo or with someone, everything you need to pick tonight's movie is free, with no ads.

records.name: Check’d
records.tagline: Home checks with timestamps, on iPhone and Apple Watch
records.description: Door locked? Stove off? Check’d records the checks you confirm, with timestamps you can revisit on iPhone and a paired Apple Watch. Start free with one active Moment and unlimited Checks. No Check’d account required.

records.name: Mediary Scout
records.tagline: Open-source AI agent for cloud drive media tracking & NAS
records.description: Mediary Scout is an open-source (MIT) AI agent that searches, verifies, transfers, renames, and fetches subtitles for movies, TV shows, and anime across 6 cloud drives (Quark, UC, 115, 123, Guangya, Tianyi) with multi-drive space-aware routing for Infuse, VidHub, Emby, and Jellyfin.

records.name: OnyxIQ
records.tagline: TubeBuddy-class YouTube growth studio pay once, own forever
records.description: Channel X-Ray, Video X-Ray, Keyword Lab, Competitor Compare, Thumbnail Feed-Test, AI Studio and Upload Checklist. Score every title, description and tag with the built-in SEO engine before you publish. Works with your own free YouTube Data API key (BYOK) — no sign-in warning, no user limit. Your key, your quota, your data stays in your browser. $49 one-time, 14-day money-back guarantee.

records.name: Keph
records.tagline: The AI that answers what the others won't
records.description: Keph is an AI for adults that talks straight: history's dark corners, the occult, the questions others lecture you for. It reads your files, links and voice notes, searches the web with sources, and remembers you between chats. Free to try.

records.name: PRO KPO AI OS
records.tagline: The healthcare AI operating system
records.description: One connected AI ecosystem for home care, EHR-connected agencies, and long-term care.

records.name: MathBehind
records.tagline: Free calculators that show the math behind the answer
records.description: MathBehind is a free collection of 89 calculators and converters for freelancers, SaaS teams and developers. Instead of giving you a bare number, every result shows the formula filled in with your own inputs, step by step. There is no sign-up, and nothing you type leaves your browser.

records.name: DUNS Lookup
records.tagline: Full Chinese registry record from any DUNS number, free
records.description: Look up any Chinese company by its 9-digit DUNS Number and get the full registration record: complete street address (Chinese + English), Unified Social Credit Code, registered capital, legal representative, employee count, SIC/NAICS and ESG. D&B's public directory redacts mainland Chinese addresses and won't unlock them on sign-in — this reads the same registry endpoint the paid API does. Free, no sign-up; lookups run in your browser and are never stored. 6 languages, plus DUNS guides.

records.name: NotiTimer
records.tagline: Your notifications, on your time.
records.description: NotiTimer holds notifications from the apps you choose during quiet hours, then delivers them all when the hours end, so nothing is lost. Make groups like Sleep, Work or Study, give each its own days and hours, and keep calls and important apps coming through with Always allow. Unlike Do Not Disturb, it doesn't silence your whole phone. Release everything at any time with one tap. Everything stays on your phone. Free on Android.

records.name: Marengo
records.tagline: White-label crypto exchange you can try before you buy
records.description: Marengo is a white-label crypto exchange for companies launching their own, and you can try it today at marengo.paynoramic.com. Lite for everyone, Pro for traders, on 24+ markets, with a matching engine, a double-entry ledger, built-in compliance tools and a staff backoffice. Native iOS and Android apps, six languages, broker mode, FIX 4.4 and proof of liabilities. Paynoramic puts your brand on it in about 30 days and hands over the full source code.

records.name: Annex
records.tagline: use another computer as a second screen
records.description: Annex turns another computer into a second display, or mirrors its screen. Mac, Windows and Linux in any combination, over your network, a cable or the internet. Encrypted end to end. Free and open source.

records.name: FogAway
records.tagline: Uncover your walking map, one street at a time
records.description: Turn your walks into a fog map on iPhone. Record routes, revisit days and export replay videos or share cards. Tracks stay in a local database, with optional iCloud backups. Full access is paid; eligible annual plans have a 7-day trial.

records.name: DeckAI
records.tagline: DeckAI Type a topic and get a hand-drawn slides deck
records.description: Turn any topic into an hand-drawn, editable presentation deck.

records.name: سبليتها
records.tagline: Splitaha allows users to easy manage shared expenses
records.description: Splitaha allows users to easy manage shared expenses between friends, relatives, and individuals سبليتها تطبيق سعودي لتقسيم المصاريف المشتركة بين الأصدقاء والمجموعات والرحلات، ومتابعة الأرصدة وتسجيل التسويات. المجموعات والأرصدة والتسويات مجانية، وسبليتها برو يضيف أدوات متقدمة.

records.name: Huoniu (火牛)
records.tagline: Find Telegram promotion resources and use free web tools
records.description: A Chinese-language platform to find Telegram groups and channels, prepare ad copy briefs and use free web tools. Filter, preview, unlock and export public resource links. Includes 2FA, password, DNS and IP utilities. Paid resource access uses credits.

records.name: UltraNotch
records.tagline: Music, files and everyday tools, right in your Mac's notch
records.description: UltraNotch turns the top of your Mac into a workspace for music, files and everyday tools. Arrange and resize tiles, choose independent Mini and Max layouts, or expand to UltraMax with up to nine tiles. Control Apple Music or Spotify, use File Shelf, start a focus timer, check the weather and adjust quick controls. Start free with three tiles; an optional Lifetime purchase adds separate Home and Work layouts, corner controls and more customization. macOS 15+. No subscription.

records.name: SceneForge: Turning Ideas into Action
records.tagline: Now creates actionable plans with tools, prices & links.
records.description: • A more focused project-planning workflow • Better tool recommendations and cost estimates • Shopping options for recommended tools • Exportable project checklists • Improved login and account experience • Free and Pro usage options • A faster, cleaner experience from idea to project plan Our goal has become much clearer: SceneForge isn't just here to answer questions about a project. It's here to help you actually start building it.

records.name: Color Analysis Quiz
records.tagline: Find your color season from a selfie, free and private
records.description: Upload a selfie and get your seasonal color analysis in seconds: your season, undertone, best colors and colors to avoid. It runs in your browser, so the photo never leaves your device. Free, no sign-up, plus guides for all 12 seasons.

records.name: Cutout Free
records.tagline: Free background remover, no sign-up, transparent PNG
records.description: Drop in a photo and get a transparent PNG back. Free, no account. It keeps hair, fur and product edges clean and keeps your original size. Need an ID-style photo? Save a JPG with a white, blue or red background. Files up to 20 MB.

records.name: Minted
records.tagline: Turn SVG into a physically-lit 3D gold medallion for SwiftUI
records.description: Minted turns any SVG into a physically-lit 3D gold medallion for SwiftUI. Cloisonne enamel, engraved lettering, orange-peel backs, and momentum spins, all from generated geometry from your 2D paths, so your app ships zero model files. Hand it finished pin artwork and it traces the outline and renders gold as real metal, or build coins from paths directly. Six sample pins ship with the package. Swift 5.9+, iOS 17+, Swift Package Manager, MIT.

records.name: BluRelay.app
records.tagline: Field Service Operations, Unified & Automated
records.description: BluRelay unifies field service operations for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical contractors. Replace disconnected tools with one platform for AI-powered call answering and dispatch, scheduling, technician tracking, payroll validation, QuickBooks integration, customer booking, safety documentation, and more. Reduce admin work, catch payroll discrepancies before payday, capture more service opportunities, and keep your office and field teams connected.

records.name: LegalToOpen
records.tagline: State guides for home food and food truck businesses
records.description: Find state-by-state guides to selling food from home and starting a food truck. Understand permitted foods, sales options, permits, fees, and the steps to get started, with links to official requirements. Free to browse.

records.name: DesktopCat
records.tagline: A free desktop pet cat named Mochi for Mac and Windows
records.description: DesktopCat puts a cute animated cat named Mochi on your desktop. It's free on macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11, with optional paid cats.

records.name: Read the World
records.tagline: A free daily geography game
records.description: Every day the site picks a mystery country and shows you the 5 Wikipedia articles people there read the most yesterday. You get 6 guesses to work out which country it is, and each wrong guess tells you how far away you are and in which direction. It's free, and a new puzzle comes out every day!

records.name: NXTO — nxto.app
records.tagline: Game Backlog with recommendation system  - what to play next
records.description: NXTO is a free game backlog tracker: import your Steam library, see how many hours your backlog will take, and get personalised picks for what to play next. No subscription.

records.name: DocMaker AI
records.tagline: Generate, preview, and edit documents with AI
records.description: Turn prompts, templates, or source files into structured documents. Preview pages, edit text and formatting, or ask AI to revise drafts in the same workspace. Create proposals, reports, SOPs, and study guides. Free to start without an account, with 20 generation and AI revision requests per 24 hours.

records.name: npm
records.tagline: A Rust-native, lightweight process manager for Node.js.
records.description: Vexor is a Rust-native process manager for Node.js, built as a lightweight alternative to PM2. Get lower memory overhead, faster CLI operations, crash-resilient supervision, health-gated reloads, and built-in observability. Migrate using familiar PM2 configurations with backup and rollback support. Open source, available on npm. Try it, benchmark it, and help shape its future with your feedback!

records.name: Scalent
records.tagline: Smarter workflows, automated pipelines, faster deal closures
records.description: We design the systems, software, and revenue workflows that help ambitious teams move faster—with less friction. Scalent builds autonomous revenue operations and tailored client infrastructure.

records.name: All Floors Bendigo
records.tagline: Flooring Contractors in Bendigo
records.description: All Floors Bendigo specializes in carpet, vinyl, carpet tile installation, flooring repairs, and maintenance services throughout Bendigo and surrounding areas.

records.name: Blobly
records.tagline: Everything Founders Need. One Platform.
records.description: Blobly is an event technology platform for creating, managing, discovering and experiencing events, with event registration, ticketing, attendee management, calendars and organizer tools.

records.name: MediumStreak
records.tagline: Duolingo-style streaks for everything you read online 🔥
records.description: Turn your reading into a streak. Track articles across your favorite sites and watch your heatmap fill up.

records.name: Tinycap
records.tagline: Tiny screen recorder and screenshot tool for your Mac
records.description: Record a window, screen or area from the menu bar and export a small MP4, WebM or GIF. Or take a screenshot and mark it up with bendable arrows, text, pixelation and a crop. Free, open source, notarized, nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: RapPrism
records.tagline: Turn photos into AI rap videos
records.description: Create solo or duo rap videos from photos of people or pets. Start with a topic or your own lyrics, choose a visual style, then preview and download your video.

records.name: CattleBrandAI Free Designer
records.tagline: Draw ranch marks, export SVG, and explore ideas with AI
records.description: New: a free traditional cattle-brand designer alongside the AI workspace. Arrange letters and symbols, draw strokes, adjust line width, and export watermark-free PNG/SVG files without an account. Start from editable templates, preview wood, metal or leather, and optionally send a draft to AI refinement. AI uses credits; free-credit AI results are watermarked. Designs and previews need registry and maker review.

records.name: Burger Window AI
records.tagline: Freeze mid-bite, stare at the camera and pull the curtain.
records.description: Burger Window AI video generator: upload one photo and get the 12-second Burger Window AI video where you freeze mid-bite, stare at the camera and pull the curtain. No CapCut.

records.name: Encore
records.tagline: TikTok slideshows that already work, remade for your app
records.description: Paste your App Store or Google Play link. Encore finds the most viewed TikTok slideshows in your niche and makes new ones in that format, featuring your app.

records.name: PromPulse
records.tagline: Type once. Ask multiple AIs. Collaborate smarter.
records.description: Stop copy-pasting between AI tabs. PromPulse connects the AI websites you already use in one browser workflow. Drag web text into an AI chat, send the same prompt to multiple AIs, and compare answers in up to four side-by-side windows. Create prompt templates with {{variables}} and recall them with /. Save valuable passages from webpages and AI chats, then insert or drag them into your next task. Works with your existing AI accounts. No API keys needed.

records.name: Merrylet
records.tagline: Your dog, your family, painted into a card that plays
records.description: Greeting cards that pop up, play and unfold on your phone. Add one photo and your dog, cat, kids or partner get painted into the card in its own storybook style: on the drum in the birthday band, or a bronze statue in the town square. Opens in any browser.

records.name: BentoFolio
records.tagline: BentoFolio  a portfolio for people who ship
records.description: Ship your personal portfolio in 5 minutes. BentoFolio is an ultra-minimal, high-converting single-page portfolio template crafted specifically for developers, indie hackers, and solo founders. Built with modern bento-grid aesthetics, dark mode by default, and zero setup friction. What’s inside: 🍱 Interactive Bento Grid &⚡ Live & 🛠️ Tech Stack Pills & 💬 One-Click Connect 🚀 100% Free to Remix build with Lovabel.

records.name: CSS Button Generator
records.tagline: Design buttons visually, copy clean CSS. Free, no signup
records.description: Design the perfect button without writing CSS by hand. Start from 12 presets (Primary, Success, Gradient, Outline, Pill, Neon, Ghost, 3D and more) or hit Randomize. Customize colors and gradients, font, size, weight and letter spacing, padding, border radius, borders and box shadow. Add hover effects like Grow, Lift or Shrink with smooth transitions. Preview on light and dark backgrounds, then copy clean CSS and HTML in one click. 100% free, no signup.

records.name: Opus 5.5 Video Generator
records.tagline: Turn a text prompt into a 1080p motion-graphics MP4
records.description: Describe a video and Claude Opus 5.5 storyboards it, writes the animation as code and checks its own preview frames, then we render every frame to a 1080p, 30 fps MP4 with music. Built for launch videos, explainers, kinetic typography, animated charts and social ads where text, numbers and brand colors must stay exact. 15 to 60 seconds, 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, no install or API key, and failed videos are refunded.
